summary: Iteration 837 verification pass on static export. The iteration_836-flagged LIGHT-mode SIGN IN button inconsistency is FIXED: /auth/login SIGN IN button (testid login-submit-button) text now renders WHITE rgb(255,255,255) on dark teal rgb(15,118,110) in light mode, matching all other light-mode primary CTAs. In dark mode it renders dark-ink rgb(11,18,32) on teal rgb(20,184,166) per V2 spec. Login flow works end-to-end for admin. FPS Game hub 'Join or Create Room' button verified in both themes. AI Learning Hub regressions intact (dark-ink-on-teal Generate Course, amber flame KPI streak/momentum, primary CTAs correct). No new console errors beyond pre-existing 401 on /api/auth/me during bootstrap.

critical_code_review_comments: Login button token unification is complete: primaryBtnText/recoveryPrimaryBtnText/guidancePrimaryBtnText/tabTextActive now consume T.onPrimary which resolves to colors.primaryText per theme. Runtime verification confirms this matches the V2 spec exactly in both light (#FFFFFF/#0F766E) and dark (#0B1220/#14B8A6).
FpsGameHub 'Join or Create Room' button and its icon/label are now theme-token driven and render correctly in both palettes.

The theme-token-validity Check C (hardcoded-hex-on-interactive-elements) is a strong long-term guardrail; runtime spot-checks around FPS Game and AI Learning Hub primary CTAs show no visual regressions from the eight tokenization refactors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static export (dist mode) at https://visa-polish-v2.preview.emergentagent.com. Login theme toggle testid is 'login-theme-toggle' (single icon at top-right of the login card; click cycles between light and dark). Post-login sidebar theme toggles are 'theme-toggle-light' / 'theme-toggle-system' / 'theme-toggle-dark' at bottom of the left rail. Public landing (/welcome) exposes 'welcome-theme-toggle-*' variants. Login flow with data-testid: fill 'input[type="email"]' and 'input[type="password"]', click 'login-submit-button', wait for URL change; a 'Resume Dashboard' / 'Go to Home instead' modal may appear on landing. Cloudflare may occasionally intercept the root '/' navigation with a security check; navigate directly to feature routes (e.g., /ai-learning-hub, /features/fps-game) with wait_until='domcontentloaded' to avoid that. LearningCinema Resume button was not spot-checked in this pass (admin account did not surface the cinema hero on Discover; review said 'Skip if not rendered').
rca of the issue: N/A - verification pass. The iteration_836 flagged issue (SIGN IN light-mode text = dark navy rgb(15,23,42) instead of white) has been resolved by (a) adding onPrimary: colors.primaryText to the login palette in useLoginController.ts / useLoginControllerLegacy.ts and (b) swapping T.white to T.onPrimary in loginStyles.ts (primaryBtnText, recoveryPrimaryBtnText, guidancePrimaryBtnText, tabTextActive). Runtime CSS now returns rgb(255,255,255) on rgb(15,118,110) in light and rgb(11,18,32) on rgb(20,184,166) in dark. WCAG contrast: light 5.87:1 (AA large text pass), dark 7.52:1 (AAA pass).
